title: Grand Champion of Indigo Plateau
party_selection_rule: Full 6 vs 6 Flat Level 100 Champion Rematch
overview: Rival Blue returns to head the Tier 5 Elite Four Rematch at Indigo Plateau with an absolute Level 100 competitive squad. His team synergizes aggressive weather, Speed Boost momentum, and formidable physical wallbreakers: lead Tyranitar/Arcanine sets Sand Stream to bolster Special Defense; Aegislash/Aerodactyl leverages Stance Change with high-velocity Flying/Steel coverage; Alakazam/Blaziken cascades Speed boosts with blistering special mixed offense; and his ace Blastoise/Charizard anchors with dual elemental mastery. Victory demands tight defensive switching, priority counter-play, and seamless type-immunity pivoting.

roster.tactics: Sets permanent Sandstorm with high physical bulk. Invalidate it immediately with 4x STAB Water or Ground attacks like Crabhammer, Surf, or Earthquake.
Switches between 150 defenses in Shield Forme and 150 offenses in Blade Forme. Beware King's Shield attack drops on physical contact; strike in Blade Forme with Fire or Electric moves.
Gains +1 Speed at the end of every turn with Speed Boost. Focus Sash prevents an OHKO. Neutralize its momentum immediately with priority attacks (Extreme Speed, Aqua Jet) or paralysis.
Intimidate lowers your lead's Attack before setting up Dragon Dance. Obliterate it with a 4x Electric attack like Thunderbolt or Thunder from Magnezone or Jolteon.
Immense 160 Attack and colossal HP. Choice Band delivers terrifying physical blows. Use Ghost immunity pivots or heavy physical Fighting counters like Close Combat.
Blue's ace combines high mixed bulk and sustained recovery. Shock it instantly with 4x Electric attacks or overwhelm it with fast Rock artillery.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Lead with Kingler/Primeape to shatter Tyranitar/Arcanine with Crabhammer. Pivot Gyarados/Arbok in to Intimidate Snorlax/Slaking and Alakazam/Blaziken, crippling them with Glare paralysis. Lapras and Alakazam/Weezing wipe out Aegislash and Blastoise/Charizard, while Venusaur/Charizard provides late-game status and Flamethrower sweeps.
starter_strategies.charmander: Lead with Primeape/Sandslash to drop Tyranitar/Arcanine with Earthquake. Alakazam/Raichu outspeeds and vaporizes Gyarados/Dragonite and Blastoise/Charizard with 4x Thunderbolt. Charizard/Venusaur torches Aegislash/Aerodactyl with Flamethrower, while Snorlax sponges powerful special attacks.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Jolteon/Sandslash is your primary sweeper, erasing Gyarados/Dragonite and Blastoise/Charizard with 4x Discharge/Thunderbolt. Blastoise/Fearow walls physical threats with Roost, while Arbok/Primeape and Alakazam/Weezing cleanly dismantle Snorlax/Slaking and Tyranitar/Arcanine.

rewards: Tier 5 Indigo Plateau Championship Title (Supreme Master)
Unrestricted Super DNA Splicer Mastery for Legendary Triple Fusions
